label: Dubstep / Liquid Riddim (Melodic, Atmospheric)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 138-142 BPM, felt half-time 69-71 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: A hazy, atmospheric intro with water sounds and a soft pad sets a wistful mood, a chordal pre-drop leads to a first drop in which a smooth, melodic bass carries the hook, and an emotive breakdown of pads and plucks gives way to a gently…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Faint, breathy, wordless vocal textures, like soft sustained pads, float in the background.
cards.palette: A soft, legato mid-bass voice with band-pass filtering and a gentle glide plays the melodic hook in the drops, over a mono sine sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: Tender and dreamy: a breathy verse floats over pads, the pre-chorus swells, and the hook arrives as a soft drop in which the bass echoes the vocal melody. A stripped bridge leaves voice and water sounds before a fuller final drop.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a clear, breathy, airy soprano timbre with a soft, intimate lower register.
cards.palette: A smooth, legato mid-bass plays the vocal melody as an answer in the drops, over a clean sub. A warm pad holds the verses.
cards.tempo_line: written 142 BPM, felt half-time as 71 BPM

cards.mood: Bright and tender: a gentle pluck motif opens the track, the build adds a soft riser and filtered chords, and a warm first drop lets a smooth bass sing the hook. A breakdown of pads and vocal chops leads to a lifted second drop and a…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A round, singing bass with subtle chorus plays a major-key hook in the drops over a clean sub, while a plucked arpeggio carries the intro.
cards.tempo_line: written 138 BPM, felt half-time as 69 BPM
